description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation to manufacturer" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectSeats" targetRef="Task_SelectColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectColor" targetRef="Task_SelectToiletWater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SelectToiletWater" targetRef="Task_SelectAdditionalOptions"/>

  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVodkaRequirement" name="Send vodka bar requirement to Russian team" messageRef="Msg_BarRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirement" name="Send whiskey bar requirement to Irish team" messageRef="Msg_BarRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOtherBarRequirement" name="Send requirement for chosen bar to its team" messageRef="Msg_BarRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarChoice_Join" name="Bar requirement sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements for seats, color, toilet water and additional options to manufacturing teams" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive manufactured parts from teams" messageRef="Msg_Parts"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Protocol_Split" name="Distribute test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_KeepProtocol" name="Keep copy of test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Protocol_Join" name="Protocol distributed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation from customer" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Airplane delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Specs" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Vodka" name="Vodka bar" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_SendVodkaRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Whiskey" name="Whiskey bar" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherBar" name="Other bar" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_SendOtherBarRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendVodkaRequirement" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirement" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SendOtherBarRequirement" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice_Join" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_Protocol_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_KeepProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_Protocol_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Protocol_Join" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>

</bpmn:definitions>
